use PhpParser\Node\Name;
use PhpParser\Node\Scalar\String_;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt;
use PhpParser\NodeTraverser;
use PhpParser\NodeVisitor\NameResolver;
use PhpParser\ParserFactory;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Bounded syntax guard, independent of class_exists() and Pest's class inventory.
 * Comments and ordinary data strings are not dependencies. Literal class strings
 * are checked only at conventional container/reflection/class-consuming calls.
 * Variables, computed callables and runtime class-string propagation need review;
 * this guard intentionally does not attempt PHP data-flow or execute scanned files.
 */
final class ConfigurationArchitectureGuard
{
    public const PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256 = '72004b4a083bc6ec7510290671de9e1157c15212c9c86279a05366dd80a51ce2';

    private const PACKAGES = ['core', 'drive', 'documents', 'media', 'filament', 'azgard'];

    private const RETIRED_CLASSES = [
        'vaulter\\support\\config',
        'vaulter\\support\\gateconfig',
        'vaulter\\support\\spatieconfig',
        'vaulter\\drive\\support\\uploads\\uploadmodels',
        'vaulter\\drive\\uploads\\uploadmodels',
        'vaulter\\documents\\documentsmodels',
    ];

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function scanPackages(string $packagesDirectory): array
    {
        $violations = [];
        $fixture = rtrim($packagesDirectory, '/').'/core/tests/Fixtures/config/vaulter-0.2.php';
        try {
            self::assertPublishedV02Fixture($fixture);
        } catch (Throwable $error) {
            $violations[] = $error->getMessage();
        }

        foreach (self::PACKAGES as $package) {
            $owner = rtrim($packagesDirectory, '/').'/'.$package;
            foreach (['src', 'tests', 'config', 'database', 'routes'] as $scope) {
                $directory = $owner.'/'.$scope;
                $required = in_array($scope, ['src', 'tests', 'config'], true);
                if (!file_exists($directory)) {
                    if ($required) {
                        $violations[] = $directory.':1: cannot inventory required package scope';
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                try {
                    if (!is_dir($directory) || !is_readable($directory)) {
                        throw new RuntimeException('scope must be a readable directory');
                    }

                    $files = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                        new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($directory, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                        RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST,
                    );
                    $phpFiles = 0;
                    foreach ($files as $file) {
                        $path = $file->getPathname();
                        // RecursiveDirectoryIterator does not follow directory links.
                        // Fail closed rather than silently omitting their PHP files.
                        if ($file->isLink() && $file->isDir()) {
                            $violations[] = $path.':1: linked directory cannot be inventoried';

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($file->isDir() || strtolower($file->getExtension()) !== 'php') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $phpFiles++;
                        $contents = @file_get_contents($path);
                        if ($contents === false) {
                            $violations[] = $path.':1: cannot read PHP file';

                            continue;
                        }
                        $allowConfig = in_array($scope, ['tests', 'config'], true)
                            || ($scope === 'src' && str_starts_with($path, $owner.'/src/Configuration/'));
                        array_push($violations, ...$this->scanSource($contents, $path, $allowConfig));
                    }
                    if ($required && $phpFiles === 0) {
                        $violations[] = $directory.':1: required package scope contains no PHP files';
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $error) {
                    $violations[] = $directory.':1: inventory failed: '.$error->getMessage();
                }
            }
        }

        sort($violations);

        return array_values(array_unique($violations));
    }

    public static function assertPublishedV02Fixture(string $path): void
    {
        $contents = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($contents === false || !hash_equals(self::PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256, hash('sha256', $contents))) {
            throw new RuntimeException($path.':1: published v0.2 fixture must match pinned SHA-256 '.self::PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256);
        }
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function scanSource(string $source, string $path, bool $allowConfig = false): array
    {
        try {
            $nodes = (new ParserFactory)->createForNewestSupportedVersion()->parse($source) ?? [];
            $traverser = new NodeTraverser(new NameResolver);
            $nodes = $traverser->traverse($nodes);
        } catch (Throwable $error) {
            $line = $error instanceof Error ? max(1, $error->getStartLine()) : 1;

            return [$path.':'.$line.': cannot parse/resolve PHP: '.$error->getMessage()];
        }

        $violations = [];
        foreach ($nodes as $node) {
            $this->inspect($node, $path, $allowConfig, $violations);
        }

        return array_values(array_unique($violations));
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function inspect(Node $node, string $path, bool $allowConfig, array &$violations): void
    {
        if ($node instanceof Stmt\Use_ || $node instanceof Stmt\GroupUse) {
            foreach ($node->uses as $use) {
                if (($node->type | $use->type) !== Stmt\Use_::TYPE_NORMAL) {
                    continue;
                }
                $name = $node instanceof Stmt\GroupUse ? $node->prefix.'\\'.$use->name : (string) $use->name;
                $this->checkClass($name, $use, $path, $violations);
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($node instanceof Name\FullyQualified) {
            $this->checkClass((string) $node, $node, $path, $violations);
        }
        if ($node instanceof Stmt\Class_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Interface_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Trait_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Enum_) {
            if ($node->namespacedName !== null) {
                $this->checkClass((string) $node->namespacedName, $node, $path, $violations);
            }
        }
        if ($node instanceof Expr\FuncCall && $node->name instanceof Name) {
            $function = strtolower((string) $node->name);
            if (!$allowConfig && $function === 'config') {
                $violations[] = $path.':'.$node->getStartLine().': direct config() outside owning src/Configuration';
            }
            $arguments = match ($function) {
                'app', 'resolve', 'class_exists', 'interface_exists', 'trait_exists', 'enum_exists' => [0 => ['abstract', 'class']],
                'class_alias' => [0 => ['class'], 1 => ['alias']],
                'is_a', 'is_subclass_of' => [0 => ['object_or_class'], 1 => ['class']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if (($node instanceof Expr\MethodCall || $node instanceof Expr\StaticCall || $node instanceof Expr\NullsafeMethodCall) && $node->name instanceof Node\Identifier) {
            $arguments = match (strtolower((string) $node->name)) {
                'make', 'makewith', 'resolve' => [0 => ['abstract']],
                'bind', 'bindif', 'singleton', 'singletonif', 'scoped', 'scopedif' => [0 => ['abstract'], 1 => ['concrete']],
                'instance' => [0 => ['abstract']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if ($node instanceof Expr\New_ && $node->class instanceof Name) {
            $arguments = match (strtolower((string) $node->class)) {
                'reflectionclass', 'reflectionmethod', 'reflectionproperty' => [0 => ['objectOrClass', 'class']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if (($node instanceof Expr\New_ || $node instanceof Expr\StaticCall || $node instanceof Expr\StaticPropertyFetch || $node instanceof Expr\ClassConstFetch || $node instanceof Expr\Instanceof_) && $node->class instanceof Expr) {
            $this->checkLiteral($node->class, $path, $violations);
        }

        foreach ($node->getSubNodeNames() as $field) {
            // Namespace declarations and function/constant names are not class refs.
            if ($field === 'name' && ($node instanceof Stmt\Namespace_ || $node instanceof Expr\FuncCall || $node instanceof Expr\ConstFetch)) {
                continue;
            }
            $value = $node->{$field};
            foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [$value] as $child) {
                if ($child instanceof Node) {
                    $this->inspect($child, $path, $allowConfig, $violations);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<Node\Arg|Node\VariadicPlaceholder> $args
     * @param array<int, list<string>>                 $positions
     * @param list<string>                             $violations
     */
    private function checkArguments(array $args, array $positions, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        foreach ($args as $position => $argument) {
            if (!$argument instanceof Node\Arg) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ($positions as $index => $names) {
                if (($argument->name === null && $position === $index)
                    || ($argument->name !== null && in_array((string) $argument->name, $names, true))) {
                    $this->checkLiteral($argument->value, $path, $violations);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function checkLiteral(Expr $expression, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        $value = $this->literalString($expression);
        if ($value !== null) {
            $this->checkClass($value, $expression, $path, $violations);
        }
    }

    private function literalString(Expr $expression): ?string
    {
        if ($expression instanceof String_) {
            return $expression->value;
        }
        if ($expression instanceof Expr\BinaryOp\Concat) {
            $left = $this->literalString($expression->left);
            $right = $this->literalString($expression->right);

            return $left !== null && $right !== null ? $left.$right : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function checkClass(string $name, Node $node, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        if (in_array(strtolower(ltrim($name, '\\')), self::RETIRED_CLASSES, true)) {
            $violations[] = $path.':'.$node->getStartLine().': retired configuration helper '.$name;
        }
    }
}

namespace PhpParser\Node\Stmt;

use PhpParser\Node\Stmt;
use PhpParser\Node\UseItem;

class Use_ extends Stmt {
    /**
     * Unknown type. Both Stmt\Use_ / Stmt\GroupUse and Stmt\UseUse have a $type property, one of them will always be
     * TYPE_UNKNOWN while the other has one of the three other possible types. For normal use statements the type on the
     * Stmt\UseUse is unknown. It's only the other way around for mixed group use declarations.
     */
    public const TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    /** Class or namespace import */
    public const TYPE_NORMAL = 1;
    /** Function import */
    public const TYPE_FUNCTION = 2;
    /** Constant import */
    public const TYPE_CONSTANT = 3;

    /** @var self::TYPE_* Type of alias */
    public int $type;
    /** @var UseItem[] Aliases */
    public array $uses;

    /**
     * Constructs an alias (use) list node.
     *
     * @param UseItem[] $uses Aliases
     * @param Stmt\Use_::TYPE_* $type Type of alias
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Additional attributes
     */
    public function __construct(array $uses, int $type = self::TYPE_NORMAL, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->uses = $uses;
    }

    public function getSubNodeNames(): array {
        return ['type', 'uses'];
    }

    public function getType(): string {
        return 'Stmt_Use';
    }

<?php declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpParser\NodeVisitor;

use PhpParser\ErrorHandler;
use PhpParser\NameContext;
use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\Node\Expr;
use PhpParser\Node\Name;
use PhpParser\Node\Name\FullyQualified;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt;
use PhpParser\NodeVisitorAbstract;

class NameResolver extends NodeVisitorAbstract {
    /** @var NameContext Naming context */
    protected NameContext $nameContext;

    /** @var bool Whether to preserve original names */
    protected bool $preserveOriginalNames;

    /** @var bool Whether to replace resolved nodes in place, or to add resolvedNode attributes */
    protected bool $replaceNodes;

    /**
     * Constructs a name resolution visitor.
     *
     * Options:
     *  * preserveOriginalNames (default false): An "originalName" attribute will be added to
     *    all name nodes that underwent resolution.
     *  * replaceNodes (default true): Resolved names are replaced in-place. Otherwise, a
     *    resolvedName attribute is added. (Names that cannot be statically resolved receive a
     *    namespacedName attribute, as usual.)
     *
     * @param ErrorHandler|null $errorHandler Error handler
     * @param array{preserveOriginalNames?: bool, replaceNodes?: bool} $options Options
     */
    public function __construct(?ErrorHandler $errorHandler = null, array $options = []) {
        $this->nameContext = new NameContext($errorHandler ?? new ErrorHandler\Throwing());
        $this->preserveOriginalNames = $options['preserveOriginalNames'] ?? false;
        $this->replaceNodes = $options['replaceNodes'] ?? true;
    }

    /**
     * Get name resolution context.
     */
    public function getNameContext(): NameContext {
        return $this->nameContext;
    }

    public function beforeTraverse(array $nodes): ?array {
        $this->nameContext->startNamespace();
        return null;
    }

    public function enterNode(Node $node) {
        if ($node instanceof Stmt\Namespace_) {
            $this->nameContext->startNamespace($node->name);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Use_) {
            foreach ($node->uses as $use) {
                $this->addAlias($use, $node->type, null);
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\GroupUse) {
            foreach ($node->uses as $use) {
                $this->addAlias($use, $node->type, $node->prefix);
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Class_) {
            if (null !== $node->extends) {
                $node->extends = $this->resolveClassName($node->extends);
            }

            foreach ($node->implements as &$interface) {
                $interface = $this->resolveClassName($interface);
            }

            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
            if (null !== $node->name) {
                $this->addNamespacedName($node);
            } else {
                $node->namespacedName = null;
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Interface_) {
            foreach ($node->extends as &$interface) {
                $interface = $this->resolveClassName($interface);
            }

            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
            $this->addNamespacedName($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Enum_) {
            foreach ($node->implements as &$interface) {
                $interface = $this->resolveClassName($interface);
            }

            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
            $this->addNamespacedName($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Trait_) {
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
            $this->addNamespacedName($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Function_) {
            $this->resolveSignature($node);
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
            $this->addNamespacedName($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\ClassMethod
                  || $node instanceof Expr\Closure
                  || $node instanceof Expr\ArrowFunction
        ) {
            $this->resolveSignature($node);
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Property) {
            if (null !== $node->type) {
                $node->type = $this->resolveType($node->type);
            }
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Node\PropertyHook) {
            foreach ($node->params as $param) {
                $param->type = $this->resolveType($param->type);
                $this->resolveAttrGroups($param);
            }
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Const_) {
            foreach ($node->consts as $const) {
                $this->addNamespacedName($const);
            }
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\ClassConst) {
            if (null !== $node->type) {
                $node->type = $this->resolveType($node->type);
            }
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\EnumCase) {
            $this->resolveAttrGroups($node);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Expr\StaticCall
                  || $node instanceof Expr\StaticPropertyFetch
                  || $node instanceof Expr\ClassConstFetch
                  || $node instanceof Expr\New_
                  || $node instanceof Expr\Instanceof_
        ) {
            if ($node->class instanceof Name) {
                $node->class = $this->resolveClassName($node->class);
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\Catch_) {
            foreach ($node->types as &$type) {
                $type = $this->resolveClassName($type);
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Expr\FuncCall) {
            if ($node->name instanceof Name) {
                $node->name = $this->resolveName($node->name, Stmt\Use_::TYPE_FUNCTION);
            }
        } elseif ($node instanceof Expr\ConstFetch) {
            $node->name = $this->resolveName($node->name, Stmt\Use_::TYPE_CONSTANT);
        } elseif ($node instanceof Stmt\TraitUse) {
            foreach ($node->traits as &$trait) {
                $trait = $this->resolveClassName($trait);
            }

            foreach ($node->adaptations as $adaptation) {
                if (null !== $adaptation->trait) {
                    $adaptation->trait = $this->resolveClassName($adaptation->trait);
                }

                if ($adaptation instanceof Stmt\TraitUseAdaptation\Precedence) {
                    foreach ($adaptation->insteadof as &$insteadof) {
                        $insteadof = $this->resolveClassName($insteadof);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** @param Stmt\Use_::TYPE_* $type */
    private function addAlias(Node\UseItem $use, int $type, ?Name $prefix = null): void {
        // Add prefix for group uses
        $name = $prefix ? Name::concat($prefix, $use->name) : $use->name;
        // Type is determined either by individual element or whole use declaration
        $type |= $use->type;

        $this->nameContext->addAlias(
            $name, (string) $use->getAlias(), $type, $use->getAttributes()
        );

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Configuration;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Vaulter\Contracts\IdStrategy;

/**
 * Typed accessors over config('vaulter.*'). All package code reads configuration
 * through here so the surface is type-safe and swappable models resolve consistently.
 */
final readonly class IdsConfig
{
    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

    public function strategy(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.ids.strategy', 'ulid');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : 'ulid';
    }

    /** @return array<string, class-string<IdStrategy>> */
    public function strategies(): array
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.ids.strategies', []);

        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $strategies = [];

        foreach ($value as $key => $class) {
            if (is_string($key) && is_string($class) && is_a($class, IdStrategy::class, allow_string: true)) {
                $strategies[$key] = $class;
            }
        }

        /** @var array<string, class-string<IdStrategy>> $strategies */
        return $strategies;
    }

    /** @return 'string'|'bigint'|'uuid'|'ulid' */
    public function hostKeys(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.ids.host_keys', 'string');

        if (!is_string($value) || !in_array($value, ['string', 'bigint', 'uuid', 'ulid'], true)) {
            $label = is_scalar($value) || $value === null ? (string) $value : get_debug_type($value);

            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('[Vaulter] Unknown vaulter.ids.host_keys ['.$label.']; expected string|bigint|uuid|ulid.');
        }

        return $value;
    }

    public function usesUlids(): bool
    {
        return $this->strategy() === 'ulid';
    }
}

namespace Vaulter\Load\Observability;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Vaulter\Configuration\DatabaseConfig;
use Vaulter\Configuration\VaulterConfig;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Observability\MetricsRecorder;
use Vaulter\Drive\Enums\Uploads\UploadProtocol;
use Vaulter\Drive\Enums\Uploads\UploadStatus;

/**
 * Host-side absolute gauges for load SUT state snapshots (P8.3).
 */
final class LoadStateMetrics
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DatabaseConfig $databaseConfig,
        private readonly VaulterConfig $vaulterConfig,
        private readonly MetricsRecorder $metrics,
    ) {}

    public function observeUploadSessions(): void
    {
        $table = $this->databaseConfig->table('upload_sessions');
        $openStatuses = [
            UploadStatus::Initiated->value,
            UploadStatus::Uploading->value,
            UploadStatus::Assembled->value,
        ];

        $rows = DB::table($table)
            ->select('protocol', DB::raw('count(*) as aggregate'))
            ->whereIn('status', $openStatuses)
            ->groupBy('protocol')
            ->get();

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $protocol = (string) $row->protocol;
            $count = (int) $row->aggregate;

            $this->metrics->gauge(
                name: 'vaulter_upload_session_active',
                value: $count,
                labels: ['protocol' => $protocol],
            );
        }

        $knownProtocols = UploadProtocol::values();

        foreach ($knownProtocols as $protocol) {
            if ($rows->contains(static fn ($row): bool => (string) $row->protocol === $protocol)) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->metrics->gauge(
                name: 'vaulter_upload_session_active',
                value: 0,
                labels: ['protocol' => $protocol],
            );
        }
    }

    public function observeOutboxBacklog(): void
    {
        if (!$this->vaulterConfig->featureEnabled('webhooks')) {
            $this->metrics->gauge(name: 'vaulter_outbox_backlog', value: 0);

            return;
        }

        $table = $this->databaseConfig->table('outbox');
        $pending = (int) DB::table($table)->where('status', 'pending')->count();

        $this->metrics->gauge(name: 'vaulter_outbox_backlog', value: $pending);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Load\Observability;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Throwable;
use Vaulter\Configuration\RoutesConfig;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Observability\MetricsRecorder;
use Vaulter\Http\Middleware\VaulterHttpOperationMap;

/**
 * Host collector for `vaulter_download_stream_active` via php-fpm status (P8.4 / §5.2).
 */
final class DownloadStreamMetrics
{
    private const string STATUS_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/fpm-status?json&full';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RoutesConfig $routesConfig,
        private readonly MetricsRecorder $metrics,
    ) {}

    public function observeActiveStreams(): void
    {
        $active = 0;

        try {
            $response = Http::timeout(seconds: 1)->get(self::STATUS_URL);

            if (!$response->successful()) {
                $this->emitGauge(value: 0);

                return;
            }

            $payload = $response->json();

            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                $this->emitGauge(value: 0);

                return;
            }

            foreach ($payload['processes'] ?? [] as $process) {
                if (!is_array($process)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (($process['state'] ?? '') !== 'Running') {
                    continue;
                }

                $uri = (string) ($process['request uri'] ?? $process['request_uri'] ?? '');

                if ($this->isDownloadRequestUri($uri)) {
                    $active++;
                }
            }

            $ceiling = $this->maxChildrenCeiling($payload);
            $this->emitGauge(value: $ceiling > 0 ? min($active, $ceiling) : $active);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            $this->emitGauge(value: 0);
        }
    }

    private function emitGauge(int $value): void
    {
        $this->metrics->gauge(
            name: 'vaulter_download_stream_active',
            value: $value,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param array<mixed> $payload
     */
    private function maxChildrenCeiling(array $payload): int
    {
        foreach (['max children', 'total processes'] as $key) {
            if (isset($payload[$key]) && is_numeric($payload[$key])) {
                return max(0, (int) $payload[$key]);
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private function isDownloadRequestUri(string $uri): bool
    {
        $path = parse_url($uri, PHP_URL_PATH);

        if (!is_string($path) || $path === '') {
            $path = $uri;
        }

        $normalized = trim($path, '/');

        if (str_starts_with($normalized, 'index.php/')) {
            $normalized = substr($normalized, strlen('index.php/'));
        }

        $prefix = trim($this->routesConfig->prefix(), '/');

        if ($prefix !== '' && str_starts_with($normalized, $prefix.'/')) {
            $normalized = substr($normalized, strlen($prefix) + 1);
        }

        return VaulterHttpOperationMap::resolve(method: 'GET', pathAfterPrefix: $normalized) === 'download';
    }
}

/**
 * Records `vaulter_request_peak_memory_bytes` after the response is sent (P8.4 / §5.2).
 */
final readonly class RecordRequestPeakMemory
{
    public function __construct(
        private RoutesConfig $routesConfig,
        private MetricsRecorder $metrics,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param Closure(Request): Response $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        return $next($request);
    }

    public function terminate(Request $request, Response $response): void
    {
        $operation = $this->operationFor($request);

        if ($operation === null) {
            return;
        }

        $this->metrics->gauge(
            name: 'vaulter_request_peak_memory_bytes',
            value: memory_get_peak_usage(true),
            labels: [
                'operation' => $operation,
                'tier' => LoadTier::label(),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function operationFor(Request $request): ?string
    {
        $prefix = trim($this->routesConfig->prefix(), '/');
        $path = trim($request->path(), '/');

        if ($prefix !== '' && str_starts_with($path, $prefix)) {
            $path = ltrim(substr($path, strlen($prefix)), '/');
        }

        return VaulterHttpOperationMap::resolve(method: $request->method(), pathAfterPrefix: $path);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Load\Observability;

use Illuminate\Console\Events\CommandFinished;
use Illuminate\Console\Events\CommandStarting;
use Illuminate\Database\Events\TransactionBeginning;
use Illuminate\Database\Events\TransactionCommitted;
use Illuminate\Database\Events\TransactionRolledBack;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobExceptionOccurred;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobFailed;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobProcessed;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobProcessing;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Vaulter\Configuration\RoutesConfig;
use Vaulter\Http\Middleware\VaulterHttpOperationMap;

/**
 * Load-host-only query trace (P3.1). Opt-in via LOAD_DB_TRACE; never stores bindings or rendered SQL.
 */
final class QueryTraceRecorder
{
    private readonly RoutesConfig $routesConfig;

    private bool $registered = false;

    /** @var list<array<string, mixed>> */
    private array $records = [];

    private int $ordinal = 0;

    private int $transactionDepth = 0;

    private ?string $commandId = null;

    private ?string $invocationId = null;

    public function __construct(?RoutesConfig $routesConfig = null)
    {
        $this->routesConfig = $routesConfig ?? app(RoutesConfig::class);
    }

    public function register(): void
    {
        if ($this->registered) {
            return;
        }

        $this->registered = true;

        DB::listen(function ($query): void {
            $this->recordQuery(
                connection: (string) $query->connectionName,
                sql: (string) $query->sql,
                durationMs: (float) $query->time,
            );
        });

        Event::listen(CommandStarting::class, function (CommandStarting $event): void {
            $this->beginInvocation();
            $this->commandId = 'artisan:'.$event->command;
        });
        Event::listen(CommandFinished::class, fn () => $this->flush());
        Event::listen(JobProcessing::class, function (JobProcessing $event): void {
            $this->beginInvocation();
            $this->commandId = 'job:'.get_class($event->job);
        });
        Event::listen(JobProcessed::class, fn () => $this->flush());
        Event::listen(JobFailed::class, fn () => $this->flush());
        Event::listen(JobExceptionOccurred::class, fn () => $this->flush());

        Event::listen(TransactionBeginning::class, fn () => $this->transactionDepth++);
        Event::listen(TransactionCommitted::class, fn () => $this->transactionDepth = max(0, $this->transactionDepth - 1));
        Event::listen(TransactionRolledBack::class, fn () => $this->transactionDepth = max(0, $this->transactionDepth - 1));
    }

    public function bindHttpRequest(Request $request): void
    {
        $this->beginInvocation();
        $operation = $this->operationFor($request);
        $this->commandId = $operation === null ? 'http:unmapped' : 'http:'.$operation;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function records(): array
    {
        return $this->records;
    }

    public function flush(): void
    {
        $path = (string) env('LOAD_DB_TRACE_PATH', '');

        if ($path === '' || $this->records === []) {
            return;
        }

        $lines = array_map(
            static fn (array $row): string => (string) json_encode($row, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
            $this->records,
        );

        $dir = dirname($path);

        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
        }

        if (file_put_contents($path, implode("\n", $lines)."\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX) === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Could not append P3 query trace');
        }

        $this->clear();
    }

    public function clear(): void
    {
        $this->records = [];
        $this->ordinal = 0;
        $this->commandId = null;
        $this->invocationId = null;
    }

    private function beginInvocation(): void
    {
        $this->clear();
        $this->invocationId = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
    }

    private function recordQuery(string $connection, string $sql, float $durationMs): void
    {
        $runId = (string) env('LOAD_RUN_ID', '');

        if ($runId === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->ordinal++;

        $this->records[] = [
            'run_id' => $runId,
            'command_id' => $this->commandId ?? 'unknown',
            'invocation_id' => $this->invocationId ??= bin2hex(random_bytes(8)),
            'connection' => $connection,
            'sql_template_hash' => hash('sha256', self::normalizeSqlTemplate($sql)),
            'duration_ms' => round($durationMs, 3),
            'ordinal' => $this->ordinal,
            'in_transaction' => $this->transactionDepth > 0,
        ];
    }

    private function operationFor(Request $request): ?string
    {
        $prefix = trim($this->routesConfig->prefix(), '/');
        $path = trim($request->path(), '/');

        if ($prefix !== '' && str_starts_with($path, $prefix)) {
            $path = ltrim(substr($path, strlen($prefix)), '/');
        }

        return VaulterHttpOperationMap::resolve(method: $request->method(), pathAfterPrefix: $path);
    }

    private static function normalizeSqlTemplate(string $sql): string
    {
        $normalized = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', trim($sql)) ?? $sql;
        $normalized = preg_replace("/'(?:''|[^'])*'/", '?', $normalized) ?? $normalized;
        $normalized = preg_replace('/\b\d+\b/', '?', $normalized) ?? $normalized;

        return strtolower($normalized);
    }
}

/**
 * Typed accessors over config('vaulter.*'). All package code reads configuration

final readonly class RoutesConfig
{
    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

    public function prefix(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.routes.prefix', 'api/vaulter');

        return is_string($value) ? $value : 'api/vaulter';
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function authenticatedMiddleware(): array
    {
        return $this->withRequestMetrics($this->stringList(
            $this->config->get('vaulter.routes.middleware.authenticated'),
            ['api', 'auth:sanctum'],
        ));
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function publicMiddleware(): array
    {
        return $this->withRequestMetrics($this->stringList($this->config->get('vaulter.routes.middleware.public'), ['api']));
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function hubMiddleware(): array
    {
        return $this->withRequestMetrics($this->stringList($this->config->get('vaulter.routes.middleware.hub'), ['api']));
    }

    public function publicRateLimit(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.routes.rate_limits.public', 60);

        $limit = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 60;

        return max($limit, 1);
    }

    public function uploadsRateLimit(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.routes.rate_limits.uploads', 120);

        $limit = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 120;

        return max($limit, 1);
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string> $middleware
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function withRequestMetrics(array $middleware): array
    {
        if (!in_array(RecordVaulterRequestMetrics::class, $middleware, true)) {
            $middleware[] = RecordVaulterRequestMetrics::class;
        }

        return $middleware;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string> $default
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function stringList(mixed $value, array $default): array
    {
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return $default;
        }

        $strings = [];

        foreach ($value as $item) {
            if (is_string($item)) {
                $strings[] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $strings;
    }

final readonly class ConfigValidator
{
    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

    public function validate(VaulterConfig $config, Application $app): void
    {
        foreach ($this->config->all() as $root => $values) {
            if ($root === 'vaulter' || str_starts_with((string) $root, 'vaulter-')) {
                $this->assertNoClosures($values, (string) $root);
            }
        }

        $access = $config->access();
        $key = $access->permissionDriver();
        $drivers = $access->permissionDrivers();
        if (!isset($drivers[$key])) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Unknown vaulter.access.permission_driver "'.$key.'".');
        }
        self::assertImplements('vaulter.access.permission_drivers.'.$key, $drivers[$key], PermissionDriver::class);
        if ($app->environment('production') && is_a($drivers[$key], NonProductionPermissionDriver::class, true)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Non-production permission driver "'.$key.'" is forbidden in production.');
        }
        // These accessors validate the untrusted class strings before returning them.
        $config->webhooks()->urlGuard();
        $config->sharing()->tokenGenerator();
        foreach ([
            'drive' => Drive::class,
            'node' => Node::class,
            'file' => File::class,
            'file_revision' => FileRevision::class,
            'file_revision_blob' => FileRevisionBlob::class,
            'blob' => Blob::class,
            'grant' => NodeGrant::class,
            'node_share' => NodeShare::class,
            'activity' => Activity::class,
            'outbox' => Outbox::class,
            'webhook_endpoint' => WebhookEndpoint::class,
            'webhook_delivery' => WebhookDelivery::class,
        ] as $key => $base) {
            self::assertModel('vaulter.models.'.$key, $config->model($key), $base);
        }

        $classes = [$config->defaultProfile(), ...$config->profileProviders()];
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($classes as $class) {
            $provider = $app->make($class);
            if (!$provider instanceof ProfileProvider) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Container binding for profile provider "'.$class.'" must return a ProfileProvider.');
            }
            $id = $provider->resolve()->getId();
            if ($id === '' || isset($ids[$id])) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Profile keys must be nonempty and unique; duplicate "'.$id.'".');
            }
            $ids[$id] = true;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @template T of \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
     *
     * @param class-string<T> $base
     *
     * @phpstan-assert class-string<T> $class
     */
    public static function assertModel(string $key, string $class, string $base): void
    {
        self::assertImplements($key, $class, $base);
    }

    /**
     * @template T of object
     *
     * @param class-string<T> $base
     *
     * @phpstan-assert class-string<T> $class
     */
    public static function assertImplements(string $key, string $class, string $base): void
    {
        if ($class === '' || !class_exists($class) || !is_a($class, $base, true)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Config key "'.$key.'" must name a class implementing or extending '.$base.'; got "'.$class.'".');
        }
    }

    public static function assertCollaborationSecrets(bool $enabled, ?string $jwtSecret, ?string $webhookSecret, Application $app): void
    {
        if (!$enabled || ($jwtSecret !== null && $jwtSecret !== '' && $webhookSecret !== null && $webhookSecret !== '' && $jwtSecret !== $webhookSecret)) {
            return;
        }
        $message = '[Vaulter] Collaboration requires nonempty, different JWT and webhook secrets.';
        if ($app->environment('production')) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException($message);
        }
        Log::warning($message);
    }

    private function assertNoClosures(mixed $value, string $key): void
    {
        if ($value instanceof Closure) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Config key "'.$key.'" contains a Closure; use a FQCN or scalar value.');
        }
        if (is_array($value)) {
            foreach ($value as $name => $item) {
                $this->assertNoClosures($item, $key.'.'.$name);
            }
        }
    }

<?php declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpParser\Node;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\NodeAbstract;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Use_;

class UseItem extends NodeAbstract {
    /**
     * @var Use_::TYPE_* One of the Stmt\Use_::TYPE_* constants. Will only differ from TYPE_UNKNOWN for mixed group uses
     */
    public int $type;
    /** @var Node\Name Namespace, class, function or constant to alias */
    public Name $name;
    /** @var Identifier|null Alias */
    public ?Identifier $alias;

    /**
     * Constructs an alias (use) item node.
     *
     * @param Node\Name $name Namespace/Class to alias
     * @param null|string|Identifier $alias Alias
     * @param Use_::TYPE_* $type Type of the use element (for mixed group use only)
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Additional attributes
     */
    public function __construct(Node\Name $name, $alias = null, int $type = Use_::TYPE_UNKNOWN, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->alias = \is_string($alias) ? new Identifier($alias) : $alias;
    }

    public function getSubNodeNames(): array {
        return ['type', 'name', 'alias'];
    }

    /**
     * Get alias. If not explicitly given this is the last component of the used name.
     */
    public function getAlias(): Identifier {
        if (null !== $this->alias) {
            return $this->alias;
        }

        return new Identifier($this->name->getLast());
    }

    public function getType(): string {
        return 'UseItem';
    }
}

// @deprecated compatibility alias
class_alias(UseItem::class, Stmt\UseUse::class);

namespace Vaulter\Models\Concerns;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

use function Illuminate\Support\enum_value;

use Vaulter\Configuration\DatabaseConfig;

/**
 * Every default Vaulter model reads its database connection from
 * `configuration key vaulter.database.connection` (F-P2.3-02) instead of always resolving to the
 * host's default connection. `app(\Vaulter\Configuration\DatabaseConfig::class)->connection()` returns null when the key is
 * unset, and `null` is exactly what `Model::getConnectionName()` already returned
 * before this trait existed — a host that never sets the key sees no change in
 * behaviour, only a host that DOES set it gets every Vaulter-owned table's model
 * routed to that named connection, matching where {@see
 * \Vaulter\Schema\SchemaBuilder} created the table.
 *
 * Host apps that swap in their own model (configuration key vaulter.models.*) simply omit
 * this trait if they want a different connection resolution strategy.
 *
 * @mixin Model
 */
trait ResolvesVaulterConnection
{
    #[\Override]
    public function getConnectionName(): ?string
    {
        // Mirrors Model::getConnectionName()'s own enum_value() resolution (a
        // model MAY set $connection to a backed/unit enum) before falling back to
        // the package-wide config key, so an explicit per-model override still wins.
        $name = enum_value($this->connection);

        return is_string($name) ? $name : app(DatabaseConfig::class)->connection();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Media;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Spatie\LaravelPackageTools\Package;
use Spatie\LaravelPackageTools\PackageServiceProvider;
use Vaulter\Configuration\ConfigNormalizer;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\ContentStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\StorageDriver;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Vaulter\Media\Configuration\MediaConfig;
use Vaulter\Media\Console\GcBlobsCommand;
use Vaulter\Media\Console\ReconcileBlobsCommand;
use Vaulter\Media\Console\RepairBlobScopesCommand;

/**
 * Vaulter Media — the content-addressed file/blob layer (CAS), extracted from
 * vaulter-core (P2 #5, ADR decisions D2/D3). This package OWNS the concrete CAS
 * engine (ContentStore / StorageDriver / BlobStore implementations, the two-phase
 * GC + reconciler and their commands); the seam contracts, the Blob model/schema
 * and the per-file ACL stay in core (ACL-agnostic CAS — the media layer never
 * touches AccessResolver).
 *
 * Dependency direction is one-way: media requires core (for the Contracts\Cas\*
 * seam, the Blob/FileRevision models and Configuration\VaulterConfig), core does NOT require
 * media at runtime — a host that wants the CAS file layer installs this package
 * and Laravel auto-discovers this provider, which binds the concrete engine.
 */
final class VaulterMediaServiceProvider extends PackageServiceProvider
{
    public function configurePackage(Package $package): void
    {
        $package
            ->name('vaulter-media')
            ->hasConfigFile()
            ->hasCommand(GcBlobsCommand::class)
            ->hasCommand(ReconcileBlobsCommand::class)
            ->hasCommand(RepairBlobScopesCommand::class);
    }

    public function packageRegistered(): void
    {
        $path = __DIR__.'/../config/vaulter-media.php';
        $this->mergeConfigFrom(path: $path, key: 'vaulter-media');
        $this->app->singleton(MediaConfig::class, fn (Container $app): MediaConfig => new MediaConfig($app->make('config')));
        $this->app->singletonIf(ConfigNormalizer::class);
        $this->app->make(ConfigNormalizer::class)->registerDefaults(root: 'vaulter-media', path: $path);
        $this->app->bind('vaulter.dedup_scope', fn (Container $app): string => $app->make(MediaConfig::class)->dedupScope());

        $this->app->singleton(StorageDriver::class, static function (Container $app): StorageDriver {
            $service = $app->make($app->make(MediaConfig::class)->storageDriver());
            if (!$service instanceof StorageDriver) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Configured storageDriver binding must implement StorageDriver.');
            }

            return $service;
        });
        $this->app->singleton(ContentStore::class, static function (Container $app): ContentStore {
            $service = $app->make($app->make(MediaConfig::class)->contentStore());
            if (!$service instanceof ContentStore) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Configured contentStore binding must implement ContentStore.');
            }

            return $service;
        });
        $this->app->bind(BlobStore::class, static function (Container $app): BlobStore {
            $service = $app->make($app->make(MediaConfig::class)->blobStore());
            if (!$service instanceof BlobStore) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Configured blobStore binding must implement BlobStore.');
            }

            return $service;
        });
    }

    public function packageBooted(): void
    {
        $config = $this->app->make(MediaConfig::class);
        $config->contentStore();
        $config->storageDriver();
        $config->blobStore();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Documents\Providers;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Symfony\Component\HtmlSanitizer\HtmlSanitizer;
use Symfony\Component\HtmlSanitizer\HtmlSanitizerConfig;
use Symfony\Component\HtmlSanitizer\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use Vaulter\Configuration\ConfigNormalizer;
use Vaulter\Documents\Configuration\DocumentsConfig;
use Vaulter\Documents\Contracts\ExportFilenameResolver;
use Vaulter\Documents\Engines\Handlers\TipTapHandler;
use Vaulter\Documents\Engines\Handlers\UniverHandler;
use Vaulter\Documents\Export\DefaultExportFilenameResolver;

final class BindingsRegistrar extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        $path = __DIR__.'/../../config/vaulter-documents.php';
        $this->mergeConfigFrom(path: $path, key: 'vaulter-documents');
        $this->app->singleton(DocumentsConfig::class, fn (Container $app): DocumentsConfig => new DocumentsConfig($app->make('config')));
        $this->app->singletonIf(ConfigNormalizer::class);
        $this->app->make(ConfigNormalizer::class)->registerDefaults(root: 'vaulter-documents', path: $path);

        $this->app->bind('vaulter.document_exporters', fn (Container $app): array => $app->make(DocumentsConfig::class)->exporters());
        $this->app->tag([TipTapHandler::class], 'vaulter.file_handlers');

        if ($this->app->make(DocumentsConfig::class)->spreadsheetsEnabled()) {
            $this->app->tag([UniverHandler::class], 'vaulter.file_handlers');
        }

        // The export filename seam (P4.5 / F-P3.1-04): NodeExportService stays
        // `final` (H.5 arch gate), so a host wanting a different export filename
        // scheme rebinds this contract to its own class instead of forking the
        // service. Bound to the pre-P4.5 hardcoded scheme (node basename + exporter
        // extension) — default behaviour is unchanged.
        $this->app->bind(ExportFilenameResolver::class, DefaultExportFilenameResolver::class);

        // Second echelon of the F-P1.11-01 stored-XSS fix (D4): TipTapRenderer takes
        // the sanitizer through its constructor (never resolved inline from the
        // container) so every HTML render — including content persisted before the
        // store-time validator existed — is sanitized on the way out. Singleton: the
        // sanitizer is stateless and config-immutable per request.
        $this->app->singleton(HtmlSanitizerInterface::class, static function (): HtmlSanitizer {
            $config = (new HtmlSanitizerConfig)
                ->allowSafeElements()
                ->allowLinkSchemes(['https', 'http', 'mailto'])
                ->allowMediaSchemes(['https', 'http']);

            return new HtmlSanitizer($config);
        });
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Documents\Configuration;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Vaulter\Configuration\ConfigValidator;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Handlers\DocumentExporter;
use Vaulter\Documents\Models\Comments\NodeComment;
use Vaulter\Documents\Models\Revisions\DocumentRevision;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Vaulter\Support\Identity;

final readonly class DocumentsConfig
{
    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

    public function revisionLimit(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.revisions.limit', default: 50);

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 50;
    }

    public function autosaveDebounceSeconds(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.revisions.autosave_debounce_seconds', default: 30);

        $seconds = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 30;

        return max($seconds, 0);
    }

    public function maxContentSizeKb(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.content.max_size_kb', default: 5120);

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 5120;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function enabledDocumentTypes(): array
    {
        return $this->stringList($this->config->get(key: 'vaulter.enabled_document_types', default: []), []);
    }

    public function collaborationDriver(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.collaboration.driver', default: 'hocuspocus');

        return is_string($value) ? $value : 'hocuspocus';
    }

    public function channelPrefix(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.collaboration.broadcast.channel_prefix', default: 'vaulter.documents');

        return is_string($value) ? $value : 'vaulter.documents';
    }

    public function collaborationRoom(mixed $nodeId): string
    {
        return $this->channelPrefix().'.'.Identity::stringify($nodeId);
    }

    public function nodeIdFromRoom(string $room): string
    {
        $prefix = $this->channelPrefix().'.';

        if (str_starts_with($room, $prefix)) {
            return substr($room, strlen($prefix));
        }

        return $room;
    }

    public function hubWebhookSecret(): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter-documents.collaboration.hub.webhook_secret');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }

    public function hubTimestampTolerance(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.collaboration.hub.timestamp_tolerance', default: 300);

        $seconds = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 300;

        return max($seconds, 1);
    }

    public function hubJwtSecret(): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter-documents.collaboration.hub.jwt_secret');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }

    public function hubTokenTtl(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.collaboration.hub.token_ttl', default: 3600);

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 3600;
    }

    public function hubUrl(): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter-documents.collaboration.hub.url');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }

    /** @return array<string, class-string<DocumentExporter>> */
    public function exporters(): array
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.exporters', default: []);

        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $exporters = [];

        foreach ($value as $format => $class) {
            if (is_string($format) && is_string($class) && is_a($class, DocumentExporter::class, allow_string: true)) {
                $exporters[$format] = $class;
            }
        }

        /** @var array<string, class-string<DocumentExporter>> $exporters */
        return $exporters;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function tiptapExtraNodes(): array
    {
        return $this->stringList($this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.tiptap.extra_nodes', default: []), []);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function tiptapExtraMarks(): array
    {
        return $this->stringList($this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.tiptap.extra_marks', default: []), []);
    }

    /** @return array<string, list<string>> */
    public function tiptapExtraAttributes(): array
    {
        return $this->tiptapAttributeMap('extra_attributes');
    }

    /** @return array<string, list<string>> */
    public function tiptapUrlAttributes(): array
    {
        return $this->tiptapAttributeMap('url_attributes');
    }

    /** @return array<string, list<string>> */
    private function tiptapAttributeMap(string $key): array
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.tiptap.'.$key, default: []);

        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $attributes = [];

        foreach ($value as $type => $keys) {
            if (!is_string($type)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!is_array($keys)) {
                continue;
            }
            $attributes[$type] = array_values(array_filter($keys, is_string(...)));
        }

        return $attributes;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string> $default
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function stringList(mixed $value, array $default): array
    {
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return $default;
        }

        $strings = [];

        foreach ($value as $item) {
            if (is_string($item)) {
                $strings[] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $strings;
    }

    public function commentsEnabled(): bool
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.comments.enabled', default: true);

        return is_bool($value) ? $value : true;
    }

    public function collaborationEnabled(): bool
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.collaboration.enabled', default: false);

        return is_bool($value) ? $value : false;
    }

    public function spreadsheetsEnabled(): bool
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter.features.spreadsheets', default: false);

        return is_bool($value) ? $value : false;
    }

    /** @return ($key is 'node_comment' ? class-string<NodeComment> : class-string<DocumentRevision>) */
    public function model(string $key): string
    {
        if ($key === 'node_comment') {
            return $this->configuredModel(key: $key, base: NodeComment::class);
        }

        if ($key === 'document_revision') {
            return $this->configuredModel(key: $key, base: DocumentRevision::class);
        }

        throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Unknown documents model key: '.$key);
    }

    /**
     * @template T of \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
     *
     * @param  class-string<T> $base
     * @return class-string<T>
     */
    private function configuredModel(string $key, string $base): string
    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-documents.models.'.$key, default: $base);

        if (!is_string($class)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Model vaulter-documents.models.'.$key.' must be a class name.');
        }

        ConfigValidator::assertModel(key: 'vaulter-documents.models.'.$key, class: $class, base: $base);

        return $class;
    }
}

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : 'local';
    }

    public function dedupScope(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.dedup.scope', default: 'tenant');

        return in_array($value, ['global', 'tenant', 'drive'], strict: true) ? $value : 'tenant';

        $hours = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 24;

        return max($hours, 1);
    }

    {

        $hours = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 24;

        return max($hours, 1);
    }

    /** @return class-string<ContentStore> */
    public function contentStore(): string
    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.content_store', default: Sha256ContentStore::class);

        return $class;

    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.storage_driver', default: FlysystemStorageDriver::class);

        if (!is_string($class)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter-media.storage_driver must be a class name.');
        }

        ConfigValidator::assertImplements(key: 'vaulter-media.storage_driver', class: $class, base: StorageDriver::class);

        return $class;
    }

    {

        if (!is_string($class)) {

        $bytes = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 5_368_709_120;

        return max($bytes, 0);
    }

    public function chunkSize(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.chunk_size', default: 8_388_608); // 8 MiB

        $bytes = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 8_388_608;

        return max($bytes, 1);
    }

    public function maxChunkSize(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.max_chunk_size', default: 67_108_864); // 64 MiB

        $bytes = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 67_108_864;

        return max($bytes, 0);

    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.session_ttl_hours', default: 24);

        return max($hours, 1);

        return max($max, 0);
    }

        $keys = [];

            if (is_string($key) && $key !== '') {
                $keys[] = $key;
            }
        }

        return $keys;
    }

    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.metadata.max_value_length', default: 512);

        return max($length, 1);
    }

    {

        $days = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 30;

        return max($days, 0);
    }

    public function nameMaxLength(): int
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.names.max_length', default: 255);

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 255;

        }

        $strings = [];

        foreach ($value as $item) {
            if (is_string($item)) {
                $strings[] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $strings;
    }

    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.enabled', default: true);

    }

nodes, drives or files, documents without revisions, and own-tables installations.

rather than `require-dev`; installing either also installs Drive and its Media
backend. Update your Composer lock accordingly. Filament Move now requires
workspace creation access and Create on the destination, including the storage
root. A denied move leaves the node in place and shows "Move not allowed".

510→

wins for protected routes, including an empty list. Public shares and signed hub
callbacks use their own `public` and `hub` stacks; metrics are appended once to
all stacks. Replace PHP calls to `Config::middleware()` with the corresponding
`authenticatedMiddleware()`, `publicMiddleware()` or `hubMiddleware()`.

use RuntimeException;
use Vaulter\Configuration\RoutesConfig;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;

/**
 * Base for every Vaulter error — catch this to handle all package failures.
 */
class VaulterException extends RuntimeException
{
    public function render(Request $request): JsonResponse|false
    {
        if (!$this instanceof ProblemException) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$request->expectsJson() && !$request->is(trim(app(RoutesConfig::class)->prefix(), '/').'/*')) {
            return false;
        }

        return new JsonResponse(
            ['message' => $this->getMessage(), 'code' => $this->problemCode()] + $this->renderExtras(),
            $this->httpStatus(),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function renderExtras(): array
    {
        return [];
    }

    protected static function docs(string $anchor): string
    {
        return 'https://github.com/axiomasoft/vaulter/blob/main/docs/guide/errors.md#'.$anchor;
    }
}

    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.access.permission_driver', 'database');

        if (!is_string($value) || $value === '') {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter.access.permission_driver must be a nonempty driver key.');
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    public function permissionDrivers(): array
    {
        $drivers = $this->config->get('vaulter.access.permission_drivers', []);
        if (!is_array($drivers)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter.access.permission_drivers must be a class map.');
        }
        foreach ($drivers as $key => $class) {
            if (!is_string($key) || !is_string($class)) {
                throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Invalid permission driver class map.');
            }
        }

        /** @var array<string, string> $drivers */
        return $drivers;
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    public function gateAbilityMap(): array
    {
        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.access.gate.abilities', $this->gateDefaults());

        if (!is_array($value)) {
            return $this->gateDefaults();
        }

        $map = [];

        foreach ($value as $level => $ability) {
            if (is_string($level) && is_string($ability) && $ability !== '') {
                $map[$level] = $ability;
            }
        }

        return $map === [] ? $this->gateDefaults() : $map;
    }

        $value = $this->config->get('vaulter.access.gate.create_ability', 'vaulter.create');
